{{Top|leg}}
A '''fuel slug''' was a solid form of condensed [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] or propellant. [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighters]] made use of [[Solid fuel-concentrate slug]]s, a type of fuel slug. [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] used this type of fuel.

Fuel slugs were used in [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrills]], where they were ignited by catalysts charged by [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]]. The resulting reaction caused an intense energy conversion process that was funnelled in the drill's [[Actuator/Legends|actuator]] to produce a high-powered energized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] cutting beam.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
